title: List a pram
ask: Our youngest has outgrown the pram, so please write a listing for it. Details are in item.md and comps.csv shows what others sold for.
background: It is a three-wheel jogger style with a bassinet attachment, used for two kids.
The rain cover has a small tear near the zip.
My sister-in-law Bronwyn might want it, but she has not said yes and I don't want to chase her.

constraints.text: show the price in dollars and keep it to $300 at most
list what comes with it as bullet points, exactly three
include a line that starts "Folded size:"
don't say "smoke free" or "pet free", we have a dog
mention the tear in the rain cover

start.item.md:
Three-wheel pram with bassinet attachment.
Rain cover has small tear near zip.
Folds to 85 x 60 x 35 cm.
Pickup: Ryde.
